guard/30583.htm.text: Centurion Petukai: I, Petukai, am a Centurion, charged with protecting the King's Hall. What business brings you here?! You're here to see Kakai, aren't you? Well, you'll wind him on the second floor. You must not forget to show the proper deference to the mighty King of the Orcs !

links.text: "Tell me more about the King of the Orcs."
"Who is the Lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/30583-1.htm.text: Centurion Petukai: You know there are six tribes of the Orc? Chiefs from the six tribes gather together and select one king. Kakai was selected from the Hestui. Only the Overlords have the right to be a king. If an Orc Shaman performs great deeds and becomes famous, he or she may become an Overlord.

Q00009_IntoTheCityOfHumans/30583-01.htm.text: Centurion Petukai: I am devoted to the subject of power! Specifically, what is the most powerful thing in the world? Of course, dragons are quite formidable! But there is a beast who can subjugate even the mightiest of dragons! They are called Humans. We creatures of Pa'agrio are familiar with this…

Q00009_IntoTheCityOfHumans/30583-02.html.text: Centurion Petukai: I am devoted to the subject of power! What is the most powerful thing in the world? (Only Orcs of Level 3 or above can undertake this quest).

Q00009_IntoTheCityOfHumans/30583-03.html.text: Centurion Petukai: I am devoted to the subject of power! What is the most powerful thing in the world? (Only Orcs of Level 3 or above can undertake this quest).

Q00009_IntoTheCityOfHumans/30583-05.html.text: Centurion Petukai: Arise, Orc Warrior! Visit Seer Tanapi at the Temple of Flames ! He is very wise! He will know the answer to my question!

Q00009_IntoTheCityOfHumans/30583-04.htm.text: Centurion Petukai: Good job! No Orc has sought to answer this question until now! Now, go to Seer Tanapi at the Temple of Flames . He's the wisest of all Orcs and is sure to know the answer. Go now! Go to Seer Tanapi!
